position_overview: CG UNITED INSURANCE LTD ABOUT US | We are CG Group, a leading regional insurance and financial services provider with a footprint that spans over twenty (20) territories across the Caribbean. Through our subsidiaries; including CG United; we offer a comprehensive range of premier insurance and financial solutions to both individual and corporate clients. At CG, we believe in putting people firstour customers and our employees. When you join our team, you can look forward to working with a financially strong insurance Group that provides career opportunities across the Caribbean and our product lines, we see our employees continuous professional development as a way of life. THE ROLE | The Underwriter is responsible for evaluating and underwriting both Personal and Commercial Lines risks in accordance with Company guidelines, delegated authority levels, regulatory requirements, and sound underwriting principles. The role supports profitable growth, service excellence, quality documentation, renewal retention, and effective collaboration across the underwriting value chain. THE PERSON | To be the ideal candidate you must have 3 years of experience, completed or pursuing Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) Diploma Level or equivalent insurance qualification (as an asset). Another asset is completion or pursuing a Bachelors degree in Insurance & Risk Management, Business Management, or a related field. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office programmes, particularly Word and Excel, strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills as well as the ability to work independently and collaboratively, with sound judgement and attention to detail. THE BENEFITS | An attractive remuneration and benefits package is being offered commensurate with the candidates experience. Our benefits package includes participation in the Group Life, Medical Insurance and Pension Schemes, opportunities for training & development, Paid time off for vacation and sick leave and a hybrid work schedule depending on the position. Please mention the word **FLASHY** and tag RNDAuODEuNDIuMTc4 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNDAuODEuNDIuMTc4). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
